description: Cases of the Markdown subset of meeting cards. The backend normalises every 'input' to 'expected', and 'expected' to itself; the card editor loads 'expected' and writes it back unchanged. 'users' are the user ids a mention may name and 'files' the meeting file ids an image may show. The rules are in backend/src/modules/workspace/domain/services/meeting_markdown.py.

cases.name: heading, paragraph and list stay as they are
cases.input:
### Decisions

- Cycle time target **9.5 s** stays.
- Delivery stays in week 6/2027.
cases.expected:
### Decisions

- Cycle time target **9.5 s** stays.
- Delivery stays in week 6/2027.

cases.name: a blank line goes between a heading and the block after it
other heading levels become text
underscores read as asterisks, inside words they stay
bold inside italic and italic inside bold
an unmatched delimiter becomes text
bullet markers become dashes, deeper levels join the second
numbers run on from the first item and a blank line between items goes
numbers start at the first item's number
numbers are right-aligned from ten items on
a bullet list nested in a numbered list is indented by the number's width
a list item takes the lines after it
cases.input:
- item
continued lazily
  indented continuation

After
cases.expected:
- item
  continued lazily
  indented continuation

After

cases.name: a bullet list and a numbered list are two blocks
empty list items stay
line breaks inside a paragraph stay, trailing spaces go
cases.input:
Line one
Line two  
Line three
cases.expected:
Line one
Line two
Line three

cases.name: quote, code block, rule and table become text
strike-through becomes text, raw HTML stays as typed
inline code keeps its content and its fence
cases.input: Use `a * b` and ``x ` y`` and `  padded  `
cases.expected: Use `a * b` and ``x ` y`` and `  padded  `

cases.name: a number or plus at a line start starts a list, other line starts are escaped
cases.input:
2026. was a year

-5 degrees

+ plus

Text
===
cases.expected:
2026. was a year

\-5 degrees

- plus

Text
\===

cases.name: backslashes are doubled unless they escape punctuation
brackets in text are escaped
mentions of known users stay, others keep their name
images of the meeting's files stay, others keep their alt text
links to http, https and mailto stay, others keep their text
marks inside a link stay
indentation of a paragraph goes
blank lines at the start and end go
Windows line endings become line feeds
